messages:
Nora: Quick plan: instead of one huge PR, let's split structured-output work into a tiny 'schema cookbook' and a separate 'parsing playbook' with short SDK snippets. Smaller diffs = faster reviews.

Vikram: agree. I'll take the cookbook (schemas + AJV snippet + 3 compact examples). Will put examples under docs/recipes/schemas/ so they're easy to find.

Jean: I'll own the parsing playbook. Will add: tryParse envelope snippet for SDK v4, a minimal regex fallback, and a short decision table: when to use function-calling vs structured output.

Priya: Heads-up: we need redirects for moved paths. I can open a link-only PR with a map and sidebar updates.

LintBot: Reminder: code fences need language tags and JSON must pass linter (no trailing commas).

Nora: timeline: drafts tomorrow, aim to merge both by Friday. Keep examples byte-small and copy-paste safe.

Vikram: PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/9999 - schema cookbook draft. Left TODO for nullable-array example.

Jean: PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/10000 - parsing playbook draft. Added SDK v4 snippet: ```js
try { return JSON.parse(text); } catch (e) { const m = /\"result\"\s*:\s*\"([^\"]+)\"/.exec(text); return m ? {result: m[1]} : {raw: text, parseError: true}; }
```

Priya: redirects PR opened and changelog blurb added.

Alex: quick review pass done. Left a small wording nit and one lint comment in the schema PR.

Vikram: fixed lint nit, merged cookbook.

Jean: merged parsing playbook after addressing the wording nit and adding a one-line SDK 3.x -> 4.x migration note.

Priya: merged redirects and updated release notes: "Docs: added compact schema cookbook and parsing playbook; included SDK v4 parsing fallback examples and redirects."

Nora: awesome, thanks everyone. Closing out. :tada:
